question: Should Comfy `workflowPath` adopt an unconditional 16 MiB compatibility limit for existing configurations, and if so what documented recovery path should users receive?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but accepting a new fixed fail-closed limit changes whether previously valid user-supplied workflow files continue to run; repository policy treats that compatibility boundary as a maintainer choice.

options.title: Approve the 16 MiB contract
options.body: Accept the bounded-reader approach with a documented size limit and a clear error/recovery path for users whose existing workflow files exceed it.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility policy
options.body: Keep the resource bound but select a different documented threshold or migration-compatible behavior before merging.

recommendation.title: Approve the 16 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded-reader approach with a documented size limit and a clear error/recovery path for users whose existing workflow files exceed it.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the intended user contract and adjust the proposed implementation after a maintainer selects the policy.
